title: cusickia minor
intro: Cusickia minor, commonly known as Western yarrow or Cusick's yarrow, is a flowering plant native to western North America. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce fever and alleviate symptoms associated with colds and flu. The therapeutic actions of Cusickia minor include its ability to promote wound healing, reduce pain, and improve digestion. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
